phrases.original: è la vita omai per me.

phrases.translation: As long as my dear love
was left me by the cruel stars,
I did not know what sorrows were,
I did not know what pining is.

phrases.translation: Let us die, yes, let us die

phrases.translation: don't do it, oh gods, don't do it.

phrases.original: che ad essi in pochi istanti
Ah che del sole il raggio
phrases.translation: Ah, the ray of the sun
I tremble: my sinews and my soul

phrases.original: né può la lingua o il labbro

phrases.translation: No one, oh God, can hear us.
The poor wretches are dead, I think,
or about to breathe their last.
They still show signs of life:
Gods, what an ordeal this is!
We can go a little closer.
I can't feel it in him.
Ah, if help is any longer delayed,

phrases.translation: there is no more hope of life.

phrases.original: sta' a veder che lor pietade

phrases.translation: Here is the doctor for you,
whether a little or a lot,
armed with a piece of iron…

phrases.original: Dove son! Che loco è questo!
phrases.translation: Where am I! What place is this!

phrases.original: Chi è colui! Color chi sono!
phrases.translation: Who is that man! Who are those people!

phrases.original: Son di Giove innanzi al trono?
phrases.translation: Am I before the throne of Jove?

phrases.original: No, tu sei l'alma mia dea:
phrases.translation: No, you are the goddess of my soul:
phrases.ipa: ˈnɔ tu ˈsɛi ˈlal.ma ˈmi.a ˈdɛ.a

phrases.translation: I know you by your sweet face

phrases.original: e alla man ch'or ben conosco
phrases.translation: and by the hand that I now know well

phrases.original: e che sola è il mio tesor.
phrases.translation: and that alone is my treasure.
These are still the effects of the poison:
That may be so, but so much fawning
(With the urge I have to laugh

phrases.original: il polmon mi scoppia or or.)
phrases.translation: my lungs are about to burst.)
For pity's sake, my lovely idol,

phrases.original: volgi a me le luci liete!
phrases.translation: turn your happy eyes on me!
In a few hours, you will see,
they'll return to their former humour.

phrases.original: Dammi un bacio, o mio tesoro,
phrases.translation: Give me a kiss, oh my treasure,

phrases.original: un sol bacio, o qui mi moro.
phrases.translation: just one kiss, or I die here.
